mechanism.claim: During a volatile completed BTC auction, repeated same-direction five-minute price and open-interest changes indicate that leveraged inventory is being created and removed in synchrony with price discovery rather than merely changing at the block endpoint. At a fresh upper-tail sign-concordance state with substantial gross OI activity, follow the completed price displacement for eight elapsed hours.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the completed eight-hour BTC return
mechanism.why_distinct: HVOIPCSR correlates absolute OI-change and absolute price-return magnitudes; HVOILSR correlates signed OI changes with later returns; GOICR compares gross OI churn with net OI displacement; expansion, purge, divergence and reconciliation candidates use endpoint OI changes. HVOIPSCR discards magnitudes inside its primary statistic and counts contemporaneous bar-by-bar sign agreement. It uses no lead, endpoint OI sign gate, funding, premium, flow, fitted outcome, prior event set, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: both completed BTC variation and gross OI activity must occupy causal upper regimes
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily OI/price sign-concordance onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.price_path: 96 exact coherent five-minute BTCUSDT bars from 480 unique one-minute rows [D-8h,D)
features.oi_path: 97 exact positive BTCUSDT period=5m observations from D-8h through D; timestamp<=D; no imputation
features.sign_pair: sign(r_i)*sign(d_i); a zero in either member contributes zero
features.sign_concordance: count(sign_pair=+1)/count(sign_pair!=0), requiring at least 72 nonzero pairs
features.block_return: log(last completed close/first completed open), finite strict nonzero
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared r_i), finite strict positive
features.causal_ranks: separate strict-prior midranks of sign concordance, gross OI activity and realized variation over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded
features.eligibility: concordance rank>=0.80, gross-OI-activity rank>=0.60, variation rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid boundary ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all completed price and OI inputs are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent contemporaneous sign-coupling of leveraged inventory and price discovery

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no aggregation, pair treatment, rank, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
